notes.title: Play the Captain Forever Universe Beta in Captain Forever Trilogy (Update 15)
notes.notes:
Hi Pilots,

[i]I've added Captain Forever Universe Update 15 to Captain Forever Trilogy.[/i]

Explore, rescue, mine, work, and salvage your way through an enormous, persistent galaxy. Captain Forever gave you things to do - fight and build. Captain Forever Universe offers a place to be.

Started 12 years ago, this project was previously titled Captain Jameson, or sometimes The Dawn Star. At the encouragement of fans I've resumed development, and I'm glad I did. With a massive design overhaul, a new renderer and graphics, and new features coming online, I think Universe is shaping up to be something special.

If you own Captain Forever Trilogy then you can play Universe right now! I'd also love to hear from you about it, so please consider joining the [url=https://discord.gg/fPrgyAhD5T]Discord[/url].

[h1=Getting Started]Getting Started[/h1][olist]
[*] Open Steam and click [b]Library[/b]
[*] Right click on Captain Forever Trilogy and select [b]Properties...[/b]
[*] Select [b]BETAS[/b]
[*] Select [b]captainforeveruniverse15[/b] from the drop down list
[*] Close the properties window
[*] Captain Forever Trilogy will now update. This usually only takes a few seconds.
[*] From your Steam library, select Captain Forever Trilogy and click [b]PLAY[/b]
[*] Select [b]Play Captain Forever Universe Alpha 15[/b]
[*] Enjoy![/olist]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Tips[/h1]
[h3]Breathe[/h3]
Without oxygen, your pilot will die. Replenish oxygen by entering atmosphere zones surrounding stations. You will need to renew oxygen licenses at oxy stations to expand your reach. Most importantly, [i]every time you leave atmosphere[/i], make a plan for where your next breath will come from.

[h3]Dock[/h3]
Docking with stations to access their services. To dock, just follow a station's red and green lane lights and nudge the docking module. Try this at the nav station near where you first spawn, to add data to your onboard map.

[h3]VMEDS[/h3]
VMEDS is your Virtual Multifunction Electronic Display System - it's your interface through to all the things your ship can do other than flying, shooting, and building. You'll see it when you first start the game, and can interact with it using number keys, function keys, or your mouse. I find the mouse pretty cumbersome though and strongly recommend using keys.

Open VMEDS with the [b]TAB[/b] key during flight to access your onboard map, ship settings, help files, and to save and exit the game.

[h3]Cruise Control[/h3]
If you have distance to cover and no threats along the way, hit the [b]Left Shift[/b] button to toggle cruise control. This allows you to travel without holding the forwards key, and also causes time to pass at double the usual rate. It's great for distance travel, but can go catastrophically wrong if you fly into danger, so take care!

[h3]Goal[/h3]
Your goal is to discover wormholes to other sectors, and defeat the Border Force patrols preventing travel between them. To do this you'll need to rescue blockaded stations and build up your ship. As you explore you'll find occasional Juliet level factories, which you can use to gain Kilo level modules and build an unstoppable dreadnaught.

[h3]Share[/h3]
Every player's world is generated from the same seed, so if you find something cool you should let other pilots know! You can find us in the Steam community pages and on the [url=https://discord.gg/fPrgyAhD5T]Discord[/url].

[h1]Changes for Update 15[/h1][list]
[*]Multiple pilots - players can have multiple concurrent pilot/ship save files, all in the same universe
[*]Wide sectors - Everywhere is big again!
[*]Metagame redesign - Discover wormholes to unlock new spawn locations, defeat Border Force to travel
[*]Boss ships moved to sector outskirts
[*]One Juliette factory, building a Kilo part, per sector
[*]Mail delivery system
[*]Coords everywhere (nav screen, main UI, mail modules, mail pickup offers)
[*]More station names
[*]Simplified score, now it's highest level of ship defeated - this is your pilot's THREAT rating, shown on VMEDS main menu
[/list]

See you out there!

<3
Farbs

notes.title: Captain Together Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pilots,

[i]Multiplayer. The final frontier. The shared voyages of starship Nemesis, Eris, Narcissus, and Artemis begin today.[/i]

This update adds a new game - Captain Together - to the Captain Forever Trilogy package. Modelled on Captain Successor, Together allows 2-4 players to simultaneously build, fly, and shoot their way through the galaxy, through local co-op and online with Steam Remote Play Together.

[h2]Getting Started[/h2][olist]
[*] Open your Steam Library and select Captain Forever Trilogy
[*] Click Play
[*] Select Play Captain Together
[*] Click Play
[*] Select the number of pilots
[*] Check the various ship manuals for each ship's unique keybindings
[*] Click Launch
[/olist]
Note that although each player has their own keys, all players share the same mouse and mouse cursor.

[h2]Playing Online[/h2]
Even though Captain Together is build as a local co-op game, it's really intended to be played online via Steam's Remote Play Together system. To use this, first launch Captain Together (as above), then press Shift+Tab to open the Steam overlay. Select View All Friends, find a friend to invite to your game, right click on their name, and then select Remote Play Together. You can find more details about Remote Play Together [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]here[/url].

[h2]Quick Chat[/h2]
Not everyone likes voice chat, so Captain Together includes a new system for communicating with other players. Simply tap your forward and reverse thrust keys simultaneously to bring up your quick chat menu, then press the corresponding thrust key to send your message. For example, player 1 (Nemesis) can tap W+S then Q to suggest the party bug out from a bad situation. Player 2 (Eris) can then hit UP ARROW + DOWN ARROW then DOWN ARROW to decline.

[h2]Finding a Game[/h2]
Remote Play Together only requires that the host owns the game, so you can invite anyone at all from your Steam friends list to join in. If your friends aren't keen, you can also hop in to the Captain Forever [url=https://discord.gg/xFzwTZU]Discord server[/url] to find pilots for your squad.

See you out there!

<3
Farbs
